vb_textbox.text: The game's trends shift over time, so stay alert and be prepared to modify your approach. At times you will score highly for clicking on purples and reds (a good score being around 6+), but then that might change and you will start getting 1s or even 0s. At that point, try then going for the greens and oranges. The game will reward you for noticing that change, and you will start scoring highly again. Then it might change again. You might also notice random curveballs with no discernible pattern. I generally noticed that purple + red are combined together, and green + orange are another combination, in terms of scoring patterns.
